title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Nokia Live, Grand Prairie | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Nokia Live in Grand Prairie, Texas, USA, on 3 July 2006.

It was the 14th show by the ninth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

Starr had previously performed at the venue on 23 August 2003. He returned there on 11 October 2014.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion

  • ‘Honey Don’t’
  • ‘Everybody Wants You’ (Billy Squier)
